arabic_html:
وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟
وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۞
translit: Wa lā tahinū wa lā taḥzanū, wa antumu-l-aʿlawna in kuntum muʾminīn.
translation: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are true believers.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr reads it as Allah comforting the believers: however the day went, the higher end is yours — the ultimate triumph belongs to those who hold to faith.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir reads it as Allah comforting the believers. However the day went, the higher end is yours. The ultimate triumph belongs to those who hold to faith.
